text: 78 1. Listen and read aloud. Summer holidays have begun. Ashish doesn’t like to sleep for a long time. Sometimes he and his friends go to the park or watch cartoon show on the T.V. They like to play cricket or hide and seek in the courtyard. Every summer, Ashish goes to his native place. There he helps Aaji in the kitchen. He also helps his Ajoba to take care of plants and trees. In the evening, he often goes for a bicycle ride with his friends. Sometimes they go to the hilltop to see the sunrise or to the beach to watch the sunset. He likes to swim in the river with his cousins. If his Amar Mama is not very busy, he takes them for a trek. Ashish likes to sleep in the open and look at the stars. Summer holidays are never too long for him. How do you spend your summer holidays? Discuss with your friends. Summer Holidays 4.11
